question: Which of the following organised the Summer Book Writing Festival in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BriBooks**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **BriBooks** is a leading platform that encourages and promotes young authors and writers to create and publish their books in a simplified manner.
 
• In **2025**, BriBooks organized the **Summer Book Writing Festival**, which aimed to nurture creativity among children and young adults.
 
• The festival provided participants with structured guidance, resources, and workshops to craft their stories and eventually publish them as books.
 
• This initiative was particularly focused on building the creative confidence of students and fostering a love for writing and storytelling.
 
• It is noteworthy that **BriBooks** stands out for its user-friendly platform that simplifies the process of writing, editing, and publishing, making it accessible to first-time authors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **BriBooks:**

 
 
• Founded as an innovative platform to empower young authors, BriBooks provides tools that make book writing an enjoyable and accessible process.
 
• The platform is designed for users of all ages, especially students, to create high-quality, professional-looking books within weeks.
 
• BriBooks focuses on promoting literacy and creativity by organizing events like book writing festivals, workshops, and competitions globally.
 
• Participants of the **Summer Book Writing Festival** often have the opportunity to see their work published and distributed, which can be a transformative experience for budding writers.
 
 
 
• **Penguin India:**
 
 
• Penguin India is one of the largest publishing houses in India, known for publishing books across various genres, including fiction, non-fiction, and children's literature.
 
• Although Penguin India actively organizes literary events and book launches, they were not involved in the **Summer Book Writing Festival 2025**.
 
 
 
• **Random House:**
 
 
• Random House is a global publishing company renowned for its wide range of publications in adult and children's literature.
 
• It primarily focuses on publishing and promoting established authors and does not typically organize book writing festivals like BriBooks.
 
 
 
• **HarperCollins:**
 
 
• HarperCollins is another major publishing house that specializes in books across genres, including fiction, non-fiction, and academic publications.
 
• While HarperCollins is involved in literary promotion, it was not associated with the **Summer Book Writing Festival 2025**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Features of the Summer Book Writing Festival:**

 
 
• Participants were given access to professional mentors and editors to guide them through the writing process.
 
• The program included workshops on creative writing, storytelling techniques, and the basics of self-publishing.
 
• Many participants had their books published as part of the festival, enhancing their confidence and skill as writers.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Initiatives like BriBooks Festivals:**
 
 
• They encourage creativity and literacy among young individuals.
 
• Such programs offer a platform for students to showcase their talent on an international level.
 
• Participants gain firsthand experience in writing, editing, and publishing, which can pave the way for future opportunities in literature.
